_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 7-day base rate shows 0% of windows moved ±2+ points — this is a textbook coil where HOLD is the skilled call until the analyst's named breakers (stablecoin_growth > 45 or fed_liquidity lifting off 0) actually fire.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both see eventual upward resolution but analyst hedges to low conviction and chop while narrative leans more bullish on the coil springing; HOLD respects the coil's statistical reality over the narrative's optimism.
next_move.confirmed_if: stablecoin_growth climbs above 45 AND btc_momentum_30d holds above 50
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed drops below 25 OR fed_liquidity stays at 0 with btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d falling from 97
